Merge pull request #19830 from sandy2008/promql-parser-custom-functions

promql/parser: allow custom functions via parser.Options

promql/parser: allow custom functions via parser.Options

#17977 replaced the package-level parser flags with parser.Options and,
in doing so, removed parser.WithFunctions (added in #12170). Since then
the only way for a downstream PromQL engine to parse its own functions
is to add them to the global parser.Functions map, which also makes
them parseable by every other parser in the process, including the one
used by the Prometheus engine.

Add a Functions field to parser.Options. When set, it replaces the
default function set for that parser, as WithFunctions did; when nil,
the default parser.Functions set is used. NewParser copies the map so
later changes by the caller cannot affect or race with parsing, and
RegisterFeatures now reports the functions the parser actually accepts.

TestParseCustomFunctions used the internal newParserWithFunctions
helper and added its function to the global Functions map, leaking it
into the other tests of the package. It now uses the public API with
its own map, and the helper is removed.

Signed-off-by: Sandy Chen <Yuxuan.Chen@morganstanley.com>

UI: Fix overeager autocompletion after closing parenthesis (#19825)

Currently when you type `rate(foo[5m])`, there is immediately an autocompletion
dropdown suggesting all binary operators. Similar for aggregation op modifiers
if an aggregation doesn't have a modifier yet. This changes it such that the
dropdown only opens in this case if the user explicitly requests it
(Ctrl+Space).

tsdb: preserve mapped chunks across replayed series references (#19805)

* tsdb: preserve mapped chunks across replayed series references

Merge persisted chunk inventories when WAL references resolve to the same
series, instead of replacing previously attached mapped chunks. Use the
startup disk reference boundary to discard chunks rebuilt from obsolete
WAL history while preserving chunks already persisted before replay.

Cover mapped OOO samples under either or both references, repeated restarts,
in-order chunk duplication, and healthy mapped chunks after WAL repair,
across both appender APIs and all sample types.
